title: Roth's Theorem with Random Common Differences
exact_target: Which independent random sets of allowed positive common differences preserve Roth's theorem for every positive-density set? The optimistic target permits inclusion probabilities only a diverging factor above $1/n$.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 100 (GREEN-010). CC BY 4.0.
Ben Green, \emph{100 Open Problems}, author manuscript with December 2025 updates, Problem 10 and its comments, pp. 7--8.
